caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a pedestal bowl or dish, rendered in shades of gray and black on an off-white background. The bowl has a wide, fluted or scalloped edge forming a symmetrical, repetitive wave pattern around the rim. The body of the bowl tapers inward towards the base, which is supported by a cylindrical, slightly flared pedestal. The pedestal itself sits centered on a flat, circular base. The object is shaded to indicate light and shadow, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The overall composition is centered, and there are no additional objects or decorations in the drawing. The background is plain with some visible signs of age or staining.
title: Compote
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
